releaseScope: The HGV route backend bounds upstream response-header and response-JSON-body wait times.
A 14.5-second server budget limits optional IC probe time while preserving an already valid HGV baseline route.
Current frontend and backend both serve FINAL.46, with no user billing or tier changes.
Exact registered HGV restrictions, maximum two IC probes, warm 30/min limit, and FINAL.36 final detour caps remain unchanged.
Route appearance, motorway preference and real-device response time require the user to retry the previously failing route.

validationEvidence.previousVercelQuotaBlocker: Resolved: production deployment now accepted and READY without account billing/plan changes.

decision: Vercel quota limiter is no longer blocking FINAL.46; API and Pages have matching public FINAL.46.
No new route-quality code change is justified before real-device same-route verification.
Do not weaken HGV, FINAL.36 detour caps, warm 30/min route-call guard, or max-two IC candidate policy.
If same route still times out, capture exact displayed error, route length or origin/destination with consent, and classify whether base HGV ORS fetch or optional IC exploration fails.
nextActions: Have the user retry the exact same highway-ON route that previously timed out on an iPhone while safely parked or as a passenger.
If it now displays, open the existing privacy-safe 高速診断 and copy the report to investigate why motorway routes may still not be selected.
If it still times out, note the exact error text and approximate route length for bounded follow-up.
Do not treat this production deployment as proof of field resolution.

requiredUserInput: After a safe same-route retest: report whether route appeared; if not, share the exact error text and approximate trip distance. If route appears but no expressway is chosen, share the existing privacy-safe 高速診断 report.
unresolved: Final.46 API deployment quota blocker resolved; no known remaining production-release issue.
